canonical_project: Fundamental Data high-impact Tucker–Grant campus / Ridgeline
aliases: Fundamental Data high-impact Tucker–Grant campus / Ridgeline
status_as_of_cutoff: West Virginia issued an air construction permit for the Ridgeline turbine power facility on August 15, 2025. Official DAQ records expressly say the application did not include a data center and was not definitive about the end user. No data-center permit, high-impact certification, county land-use approval, or construction/occupancy record was found.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: DAQ received Fundamental Data LLC application R13-3713 for the Ridgeline turbine power facility, Facility ID 093-00034, near Thomas in Tucker County.
actions.access_caveat: Application receipt is not permit issuance and the application was for a turbine power facility, not a data center.
actions.evidence_note: Power-generation air action, not data-center construction authorization.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: Final determination records state that application R13-3713 was complete on April 9, 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Completeness is an administrative air-review step, not final approval.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: DAQ public-notice materials opened the public-comment process for R13-3713; final determination records state the notice date as June 18, 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Public notice is not a permit decision.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: DAQ held a public meeting on the proposed Ridgeline turbine facility.
actions.access_caveat: Presentation is a public-participation record, not approval.
actions.evidence_note: DAQ presentation expressly says application did not include a data center.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: DAQ held the second public meeting/comment opportunity identified in the official notice and final-determination record.
actions.evidence_note: Official response records 1,605 written and 18 oral comments.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: Official NSR application list gives July 18, 2025 as the last comment date for R13-3713.
actions.access_caveat: List entry is a docket/status index; some linked Application Enhancer records require credentials. Direct PDFs were used where available.

actions.government_body: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Air Quality
actions.result_status: DAQ issued construction permit R13-3713 for Facility 093-00034, authorizing construction and operation of the stationary air sources subject to permit terms.
actions.access_caveat: Issued air permit is for the turbine power facility. Official response-to-comments says the application did not include a data center.
actions.evidence_note: Construction permit for power generation, not a data-center building permit.

actions.result_status: Official DAQ index links a February 5, 2026 final order; secondary reporting says the Board denied the appeal/reclassification request and upheld R13-3713. The scanned official order was not text-extractable, so the result is recorded as source-reported with an access caveat.
actions.vote_tally: not published in accessible official text
actions.access_caveat: Official PDF is scanned/blank to extraction; corroborating report: https://www.wvhighlands.org/2026/02/06/tucker-county-residents-condemn-air-quality-board-refusal-to-reclassify-air-permit-for-ridgeline-power-plant/.
actions.evidence_note: Air-board action on the power plant; not a data-center approval.
